name: Twimm
positioning: A French CMMS written for the maintenance company as much as for the building owner.
description: Twimm is a French SaaS platform for technical building maintenance: contract and site management, preventive and corrective intervention planning, technician mobile app with on-site reports, spare parts, quotes and invoicing tied to the intervention.
real_estate_use: In France the maintenance of a building is usually outsourced under a contract with defined preventive obligations. Twimm holds both sides: the contractual preventive plan and the corrective calls, with the technician's signed report as the evidence of execution. That evidence is what a manager needs when a landlord asks whether the contract was actually performed.
features: Preventive plan scheduling from contractual obligations
Technician mobile app with on-site signed reports
Quotes, spare parts and invoicing per intervention

use_cases.job: Prove that contractual preventive maintenance was actually carried out
Track corrective interventions across a portfolio with signed field reports
